info.title: Get Shop LIVE Performance List
info.description: Returns a list of LIVE stream sessions and associated metrics for a shop. Sellers can only query room ID data for their own official creator accounts.

get.description: Returns a list of LIVE stream sessions and associated metrics for a shop. Sellers can only query room ID data for their own official creator accounts.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: start_date_ge
parameters.description:
Start date (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone.
In the parameter name, "ge" refers to "greater than or equal to" (inclusive)

parameters.name: end_date_lt
parameters.description:
End date (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone.
In the parameter name, "lt" refers to "less than" (exclusive)

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description:
Number of products per page.
Max value: 100
Default value: 10

parameters.name: sort_field
parameters.description:
Field to sort on.
Default: gmv
Available values:
- gmv
- products_added
- different_products_sold
- sku_orders
- items_sold
- customers
- 24h_live_gmv

parameters.name: sort_order
parameters.description:
Sort direction.
Available values:
- ASC: Ascending order.
- DESC: Descending order.
Default value: DESC

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description:
Currency.
Available values:
- USD: US dollars.
- LOCAL: Local currency where the shop is located.
Default value: LOCAL

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description:
Page token, indicating the current position. Used for requesting next page data.
Leave this field empty for first time queries.

parameters.name: account_type
parameters.description:
Types of the accounts under which videos were created.
Available values:
- ALL: All account types.
- OFFICIAL_ACCOUNTS: Official accounts.
- MARKETING_ACCOUNTS: Marketing accounts.
- AFFILIATE_ACCOUNTS: Affiliate accounts.
Default value: ALL

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

start_time.description: Start time of the LIVE, unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00).

end_time.description: End time of the LIVE, unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00).

amount.description: GMV amount in the corresponding currency.

currency.description: GMV currency code (ISO 4217 standard). If LOCAL currency is requested, the value will be the local currency code of where the shop is registered (e.g. GBP).

gmv.description: Overall Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) for the live.

products_added.description: The number of products added to the LIVE.

different_products_sold.description: The number of products for which sales were generated from the livestream

created_sku_orders.description: The total number of orders created during the selected period, including those with pending payment for cash-on-delivery or PayLater. Example: If a customer orders 3 units of SKU A and 2 units of SKU B, the SKU orders would be 2.

sku_orders.description: The total number of paid orders from this LIVE during the selected period. This includes SKUs that represent unique product variations like size, colour or model. Example: If a customer orders 3 units of SKU A and 2 units of SKU B, the SKU orders would be 2.

items_sold.description: The total number of individual items sold from all LIVEs. Example: If a customer buys 3 units of SKU A and 2 units of SKU B, the items sold would be 5.

customers.description: The total number of customers who placed orders directly from this LIVE.

amount.description: The average price paid for all items divided by the number of items sold.

currency.description: GMV currency code (ISO 4217 standard). If LOCAL currency is requested, the value will be the local currency code of where the shop is registered (e.g. GBP).

avg_price.description: The total price paid for all items divided by the number of items sold.

click_to_order_rate.description: The percentage of customers who clicked product links from this LIVE and purchased those products. Number of purchases divided by the number of product clicks, multiplied by 100.

amount.description: GMV amount in the corresponding currency.

currency.description: GMV currency code (ISO 4217 standard). If LOCAL currency is requested, the value will be the local currency code of where the shop is registered (e.g. GBP).

24h_live_gmv.description: The total amount paid for orders within 24 hours of viewing this LIVE, including returns and refunds.

sales_performance.description: Sale performance data of the LIVE related to the shop

viewers.description: Number of unique viewers of the LIVE video posted during the selected period.

views.description: Number of views for the LIVE video posted during the selected period.

avg_viewing_duration.description: The average time each user spent watching LIVEs. Total viewing time divided by number of views, in seconds.

comments.description: Number of comments on the LIVE video posted during the selected period.

shares.description: Number of times the LIVE video posted during the selected period were shared.

likes.description: The number of likes a LIVE video received during the selected time period.

new_followers.description: The number of viewers who followed creators from the video during the selected period.

product_impressions.description: Number of product impressions during the LIVE video posted during the selected period, including product lists and product cards

product_clicks.description: Number of product clicks during the LIVE video posted during the selected period, including clicks on product lists and product cards.

click_through_rate.description: The percentage of viewers who clicked on product links after seeing them in this LIVE. Number of clicks divided by the number of views, multiplied by 100.

interaction_performance.description:
This object will return only when the account type is:
- OFFICIAL_ACCOUNTS:
- MARKETING_ACCOUNTS

latest_available_date.description: Latest date in local timezone where data is ready (ISO 8601 format).

next_page_token.description: Page token for the next page request.

total_count.description: Total number of LIVE stream sessions.
